title: Virtual and augmented reality
examples: Can you show me an example of augmented reality?
What kind of equipment do I need for virtual reality?
What are some jobs that use augmented reality technology?

explain.say: Today we are looking at virtual and augmented reality.

draw.text: VR vs AR: What's the difference?

explain.say: Virtual reality completely replaces your real surroundings.
Augmented reality adds digital things onto your real view.
Headsets are the main device used for these experiences.
These technologies are used in training and education.
Think about playing a video game with digital monsters appearing on your actual table.

faq.q: What is the main difference between VR and AR?
faq.a: Virtual reality puts you completely inside a computer-generated world. Augmented reality keeps you in your real world while adding digital elements to it.
asks: How is AR different from VR?
Does VR replace my real view?

faq.q: Do I need special glasses for augmented reality?
faq.a: Sometimes, but many modern devices use phone cameras or dedicated headsets to project the digital images onto your view.
asks: What equipment is needed for AR?
Can I use my phone for AR?

faq.q: What kind of uses do these technologies have in the real world?
faq.a: They are used for everything from practicing surgery to exploring history without leaving your seat.
asks: Where can I see VR used?
Are there jobs that use AR?

faq.q: Is mixed reality something different from AR?
faq.a: Mixed reality is an advanced form where digital objects can interact with and be affected by the real world in complex ways.
asks: What is the next level after AR?

faq.q: Are these technologies expensive to use?
faq.a: The equipment can be quite expensive, but simpler versions are becoming more affordable for consumers.
asks: How much does a VR setup cost?

facts: Virtual reality creates a fully simulated, artificial environment.
Augmented reality overlays computer-generated images onto the real world.
Headsets are the primary piece of hardware for both technologies.
These tools are used in fields like medicine and engineering.

quiz.say: If you are studying an ancient Roman colosseum using a device that shows digital life on top of the real ruins, what technology are you using?
quiz.why: Augmented reality keeps you in your real world while adding digital elements to it.

wrong.1: This suggests you left the real ruins entirely.
wrong.2: This does not account for the real-time interaction with the environment.
wrong.3: While related, AR describes the specific overlay process.

quiz.say: A trainee surgeon practices a difficult operation using a fully enclosed, digital simulation. What technology is this?
quiz.why: Virtual reality completely replaces your real surroundings for deep practice.

wrong.0: Mixed reality implies interaction with the real physical objects.
wrong.1: This is too general; VR describes the immersive nature.
wrong.3: AR would require the real operating room to be visible.

quiz.say: Which technology uses a headset to make you feel like you are standing on Mars?
quiz.why: Feeling like you are somewhere else entirely means the real world is blocked out.

wrong.0: This does not provide the sense of presence that VR offers.
wrong.2: AR would show Mars overlaid onto your actual room.
wrong.3: Mixed reality requires some connection to the real world.
